policy.other_dialects: comparative research only; hidden from public selector

constraints: Plains Cree (Snoek et al. 2014): locative and number/obviation are mutually exclusive in presented patterns
Possessive prefixes and suffixes must be paired by paradigm
Do not transfer nominal suffixes to TH without evidence
Require paradigm source for dialect+verb class+order+actor+goal
Do not infer form by direct concatenation
Woods Cree Starks 1987: negative particle selection not reducible to independent vs conjunct; requires assertion/presupposition context
Use Cote/Ratt/Klokeid 1987 patterns only after dialect/source interpretation
Do not assume freely ordered words correspond to freely assigned semantic roles
Do not mechanically y→th convert words as a general dictionary rule
Preserve attested spelling and variant metadata

source_map.woodsSyntax: Starks, Aspects of Woods Cree Syntax (1992)
source_map.plainsNouns: Snoek et al., Modeling the Noun Morphology of Plains Cree (2014)
source_map.crossDialect: Kang, Morphological Variation in Cree Inflection (2017)
source_map.obviation: Volchok, A Synthesis of Obviation in Algonquian Languages (2019)
source_map.historical: Pentland, The Missinipi Dialect of Cree (2003)
